rec.name: PDP Bulletpoints (USP list) Block
rec.status: Built — live in Goldkindchen store; recommended over the legacy USP block

what.text: A styled list of short benefit/USP bullets in the PDP buy box, directly under the star rating and price. A headline sits above the list. Each bullet has a bold lead phrase followed by a short explanation, and a small SVG icon (a sparkle in the example) replaces the standard bullet dot. The list can sit in a tinted box with a border and rounded corners. The example shows a bundle PDP with six bullets: set savings, kitchen-front cleaner, bathroom cleaner, universal cleaning stone, signature scent, and a good-conscience guarantee (biodegradable, free of microplastics and dyes).

why.text: Shoppers skim the buy box and decide quickly. Placing the 4-6 strongest reasons to buy next to the price answers 'why this, why now?' before they scroll. Bold lead phrases make the list scannable, and the icons and tinted box set it apart from the plain-text description. Bullets that mention the saving and a guarantee (a sustainability or safety promise) also lower price and risk doubts at the moment of decision.

how.text: Add the 'CRO | Bulletpoints' block to the Product information section in the theme editor. Put it under Star Rating and Price and above the variant picker and buy buttons (in the example it sits above the USPs/Infobox blocks). Write the headline in the rich-text Title field. Add the bullets with the lead phrase in bold. Set the list style to SVG and add an icon, either as an uploaded image or pasted inline SVG code. Turn on the border and set the border colour, corner radius and background colour to match the brand. Use Space top, Space bottom and Gap items to tune the spacing. Use this block instead of the older 'USPs' block. According to the developer, both do the same job, but Bulletpoints has more styling options such as a background and border.

items: Gap between items (10 px in example)
List style (SVG; the icon settings are required for this style)
Icon as image (upload or pick from free images)
Bullet items with bold lead phrase and text

dependencies.text: Needs a theme that includes the custom 'CRO | Bulletpoints' block in the Product information section. No app is visible in the source. An icon asset (image or SVG code) is needed for the SVG list style. The older 'USPs' block still exists in the theme and overlaps with it; whether bullet text is stored in block settings or in metafields is not shown.

items: Revenue per visitor / AOV (especially on bundle PDPs)
Scroll depth and interaction in the buy box
Bounce rate / exit rate on PDP

images.caption: Theme editor with the 'CRO | Bulletpoints' block selected in Product information. The right-hand panel shows the settings: title, spacing, border, colours, SVG list style and icon fields. The storefront preview shows the bordered, tinted bullet box with sparkle icons under the price.
